verdict: Not ready to ship: the end-to-end validator run fails (cell 16) and the notebook does not surface the validator error, so the artifact/validation loop is broken.
blockers: Cell 16 (Run validator) fails with SystemExit: 'Validator did not emit JSON_REPORT=... — cannot parse structured result.' The notebook therefore does not complete the promised artifact validation step and is unfit to teach the full artifact workflow.

tools/validate_agent_docs.py (written in cell 14) can raise an exception when run; the notebook does not capture or show that underlying exception (stderr) before raising SystemExit, so users can't diagnose or fix the validator failure.

location.label: Run the validator script — [Run validator script]

findings.text: Cell 16 raises SystemExit because it could not find the JSON_REPORT marker in the validator stdout; the notebook treats this as a hard failure without surfacing the validator's stderr/stack trace, so users cannot see why the validator failed.

The validator script may be throwing an exception when executed (so it doesn't reach the JSON_REPORT print). The notebook should capture and present proc.stderr and/or avoid failing before printing the stderr to help debugging; as-is the validation step is unreliable.

location.label: Validate Artifact 1 — structure and content checks

findings.text: The validator requires each section to be >= 50 characters; this arbitrary threshold can cause false negatives on concise but valid guidance. Explain/justify this threshold or make it configurable in the script and document why 50 was chosen.

location.label: Validate Artifact 1 — structure and content checks

findings.text: The forbidden-pattern 'literal_PASSWORD' uses the regex r'PASSWORD' (case-sensitive) but the comment suggests a case-sensitive choice; this is fragile and likely to miss many contexts (e.g., 'password' lowercase). Clarify intent or use a case-insensitive pattern.

location.label: Validate Artifact 1 — structure and content checks

findings.text: The AWS access-key regex (AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}) is a reasonable heuristic but can give false positives/negatives; document that these are heuristics and may need repository-specific tuning.

location.label: Repo selection and (if needed) demo repo creation — [Select or create target repo]

findings.text: The helper _ensure_git_identity writes a global-like git config into the target repo if user.name/email are missing; document that this modifies local repo config (not global) and could be surprising to some users.
Before committing (cell 18), add an explicit check/reminder that USE_CURRENT_REPO=False by default and warn users about committing to their own repos if they toggle the flag.

The examples in copilot-instructions.md are helpful; consider adding an explicit short note explaining why absolute imports are preferred for packaging with src/ layout (to avoid fragile sys.path hacks).
